evidence.observation: 架空菓庵 is a fictional traditional wagashi shop.
Seasonal jō-namagashi and dorayaki with tsubu-an cooked every morning, wrapped one at a time at a small counter.

references.observed_principle: An agency case study (SONICJAM) for a Kagoshima tea retailer states that its brand site is white-based.
references.transferable_idea: A white ground can carry a craft product story; spacing and layout come from this shop's own evidence, not that site.

decisions.choice: An offset split: a small two-line wordmark at left and one conceptual confection detail at right, divided by asymmetrical open space.
decisions.rationale: The making fact (tsubu-an cooked each morning, sweets wrapped one at a time) suggests one quiet focal detail, not an assortment.

decisions.choice: Fine Mincho for named craft details, deliberately quiet nav and short horizontal facts in modern sans.
decisions.rationale: A traditional shop name and named craft items read as calligraphic detail; plain facts stay in a neutral sans so they scan.

decisions.choice: Warm stone and subdued charcoal; a single dark plum marker derives from the idea of the azuki filling.
decisions.rationale: The colour accent is taken from the shop's own stated filling (azuki tsubu-an), not from a generic wagashi palette.

decisions.choice: One locally generated, explicitly disclosed concept cross-section of dorayaki; never claim an actual shop photo.
decisions.rationale: No approved shop photos exist and the fixture is fictional, so only a disclosed AI concept image is allowed by the asset policy.

decisions.choice: Quiet opening, sensory detail second, a narrow factual information ledger last; each section uses a different axis.
decisions.rationale: The description moves from season to craft to the counter; the page follows that order before a separate factual ledger.

decisions.choice: Small anchored header; link to details and verified shop info, not purchase or order.
decisions.rationale: The fixture offers no ordering or reservation, so the header must not imply one; it only reaches facts the fixture states.

decisions.choice: On mobile the concept visual follows a complete readable name; details become a one-column sequence.
decisions.rationale: The four-character shop name is the identity proof; on a narrow screen it must be read whole before any decorative image.

decisions.choice: CSS grid, typography, one isolated concept-image crop; preserve verified fact text from JSON only.
decisions.rationale: Fact text must come from the fixture JSON, never from comp pixels; one cropped concept image keeps the asset audit small.
